text: Selected Sampled[S, A, Sem, R], where S is the singleton type of the complete live SampleSpace and the space carries frame/dimension as type members. Reject keeping only F/D (too weak), adding S alongside F/D (six redundant parameters), allocating a separate owner token (duplicate identity), hiding ownership only behind structural refinements (worse generic signatures), and type-level axis tuples (hostile to runtime loading). Stable explicit spaces enable total zipWith; direct constructors return a hidden captured owner; derived exact views create fresh captured owners; checked SamplingAlignment enables zero-copy rebind.
